# SaltWatch Card 0.5.4

This release restores the intended spacing of the LOW marker beside the tank.

## What changed

- The LOW pill now sits farther left while retaining the same breathing room from the card edge as the opposite side.
- The marker remains fully inside the card on narrow dashboard layouts.
- The pill stays in the ruler gutter and does not overlap the tank glass when enough space is available.
- Responsive regression coverage was added for both regular and narrow tank cards.

## Compatibility

- Existing card configurations continue to work without changes.
- No dashboard YAML changes are required.
- The emulator and SaltWatch firmware are unaffected.

## Validation

- 49 unit tests passed.
- 41 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
- The release workflow rebuilds and publishes the checked JavaScript asset.
